definition: [ בָּלַס ] verb denominative gather figs , tend fig-trees, sycamores ( ᵐ5 κνίζων , ᵑ9 vellicans , probably properly to nip the sycamore fruit to fit it for eating, see Tristr Nat. Hist. Bib. 399 Bo ii. cap. 39, p. 383 f. ; Theodoret in Fi Hexapl. on the passage Theophr iv. 2 ) — Qal Participle בּוֺלֵס , Amos 7:14 שִׁקְמִים ׳ בּ .
